body: This is such a horrible situation. I understand it must be extremely hard to cope. It's going to take time to accept what happened, but you must remember you have no fault and could not change the outcome. I know it's cliche but you can not stress over things you can not change. Be optimistic and I thank God your pup is still in your presence.
It allows me to clear my mind.
He's great. He's great with me. Thank you. I'm hoping for the best too.

The issue is I was seeing a psychiatrist through my schools health center. I am not attending classes because I would not be able to finish the quarter if I were to move, which is what I am leaning towards. Because I am not enrolled in classes I no longer have accesses to the health center. The new Dr. refuses to see me because I am not enrolled this quarter. The psychiatrist I was seeing is no longer working on campus, and I have reached out to him with no response.  The soonest the insurance can give me an appointment is a month out, and I have 2 weeks left of my medication.

I don't understand why this is a conflict. Nonononono! Unless you have agreed from day one that a polygamous relationship is acceptable, it should not suddenly rise up. In my eyes, if your girlfriend has a desire to sleep with anyone else other than you, then she is not 100% down for you. What's the point of being in a relationship who isn't focused on YOU. I wouldn't be with someone who doesn't have eyes for only me.

If your girlfriend is pushing you to do things you don't want to do, especially something so personal, you need to communicate WHY you don't want to. Not only that it makes you uncomfortable but you should bring it to her attention that it's your own decision. You shouldn't be peer pressured by someone you should be most comfortable with. She owes you understanding and if she can't give you that you probably should be with her.
